newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka ends easier in dull market.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka ends easier in dull market.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka finished marginally weaker at 42.5150/5280 to the dollar on Monday despite recovering from early losses in a dull session.

The previous close was at 42.5050/5250. The local unit was quoted at 42.5300/5350 per dollar in early trade but edged up later after banks attempted to offload the dollar for higher gains in the call money market.

"The market was active more on the call money trading side. There were also heavy withdrawals of deposits for Eid al-Fitr shopping," a dealer said referring to the festival to mark the end of the Moslem fasting month of Ramadan.
"Many banks are in need of temporary funds," the dealer added.
Call money was traded at 7.5 to 8.5 percent, up from Sunday's 7.0-7.5 percent.
